plugin.evotool.pack.prompt: Evo Tool: the resource pack gives the tools, weapons, blocks and boss their 3D models.
plugin.evotool.welcome: ✦ Evo Tool: F with an evolving item in hand opens its menu, sneak + F evolves it. /evotool for help.

tooltip.evotool.hint: F: menu • Sneak + F: evolve • Sneak: single block
tooltip.evotool.armor_hint: Evolves by taking hits • F (empty hand): set bonuses

plugin.evotool.dimension_missing: The evolutive dimension is not loaded (restart the server once after installing the plugin).
plugin.evotool.restart_needed: Evo Tool: restart the server once to finish the installation (dimension and blocks).

plugin.evotool.help.pack: /evotool pack: get the resource pack again (3D models).
